trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, deep V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle estimated at approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge boundary; the image-right lobe displays extreme, high-amplitude jaggedness (saw-tooth patterns and deep notches), while the image-left lobe exhibits lower-frequency, shallower serration peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the leading edges towards the distal tips; trailing edges follow a concave curve toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels distributed across the dark dorsal surface, particularly concentrated on the distal half of the image-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake-like scratches) traversing the dark pigmentation on both lobes, most visible on the image-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and extreme jaggedness along the entire trailing edge of the image-right lobe; multiple circular white scars (likely barnacle attachment sites) are visible on the dorsal surface.
